title: Create: Design n' Decor - Aeronautics Compat
description: A lightweight compatibility mod that connects Create: Design n' Decor with Create Aeronautics
body:
**Create: Design n' Decor - Aeronautics Compat** is a lightweight compatibility mod that connects Create: Design n' Decor with Create Aeronautics.

It lets Design n' Decor’s kinetic blocks work naturally with Aeronautics contraptions, so you can use DnD parts in airship and vehicle builds without losing core Create Aeronautics functionality.

**Features**

- Adds Aeronautics/Offroad wheel mount support for Design n' Decor crushing wheels
- Adds Aeronautics/Offroad wheel mount support for Design n' Decor flywheels
- Makes Design n' Decor large fans behave like Aeronautics propellers
- Adds lift/thrust generation for compatible DnD fan blocks
- Adds gradual propeller-style spin-up behavior to DnD fans
- Adds Create-style stress consumption for DnD fans
- Adds Create goggles kinetic stats support
- Adds Ponder support for fan behavior
- Includes configurable fan force values

**Purpose**

Design n' Decor adds beautiful variants of blocks, but some of them are not recognized by Create Aeronautics by default. This mod fills that gap, allowing those blocks to be used more fairly and consistently in Aeronautics builds.
